description: Source code for MpesaSettings document handling, including payment request, balance inquiry, and transaction verification for Mpesa integration within ERPNext.

classes.name: MpesaSettings
classes.description: Document class for managing Mpesa payment settings and related operations.

methods.name: validate_transaction_currency
methods.description: Validates if the currency is supported for Mpesa transactions.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Performs actions when the MpesaSettings document is updated, such as creating payment gateway and custom fields.

methods.name: request_for_payment
methods.description: Initiates a payment request, splitting amounts if exceeding transaction limit.

methods.name: split_request_amount_according_to_transaction_limit
methods.description: Splits a total request amount into multiple requests based on transaction limit.

methods.name: get_account_balance_info
methods.description: Fetches account balance information from Mpesa.

methods.name: handle_api_response
methods.description: Handles responses from Mpesa API calls, logging and error handling.
